structured.message: Okay, so no timeline at all? That's not good enough for me. Can you at least tell me who to ask about when the refund hits? And can you confirm the return email will go to the address on my account? I don't remember what email is on there, so I want to make sure it's the right one. Like I said, I just want this camera sent back and my money returned to the Mastercard ending in 8484.
